notes.title: 👊💫 Punch your way through Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon
notes.content:
Hello Gauls,

Dive into an epic, brand-new adventure with Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon, available on October 30th!

[previewyoutube=qqE-_azZdAA;full][/previewyoutube]

This time, our heroes leave their beloved village for a long journey through the Parthian Empire, a faraway kingdom under threat from Roman invasion. Their mission? To save Monipehni, the King of the Parthians, who has fallen victim to a deadly poison brewed by Bahmbuhzeli, a treacherous sorcerer allied with Caesar.

Along the way, they will need to gather the ingredients for the antidote while fending off fierce Roman legionaries. They will also lend a hand to local villagers in exotic and enchanting landscapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/3d083a164f9061b28c1f09b968d7a472deaa32c1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/b1700260719f191d0bf967844dd70831e1fb4c86.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/e635758dc0f5d20d813ccdef5d41305282493a6c.jpg

Thanks to their courage, their legendary resourcefulness and plenty of wellplaced slaps, Asterix and Obelix will push back the invaders and prove that the indomitable Gauls are unbeatable, no matter how far from home they may be!

Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in this thrilling platformer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/9becc77aa75a50137d9cb73f73d231d685ea74b7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760915/848c06f838c9a499418a33b634cdcdf60c65810d.jpg

By Toutatis, these Romans are crazy!

notes.title: ⚙️ Patch available for Asterix & Obelix - Slap them All ⚙️
notes.content:
Hello Gauls,

A patch for Asterix & Obelix - Slap them All is now available!

Here is what you can expect:
📣 5 new languages: Russian, Polish, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese
💻 New options for the PC version:
	• Option for full screen or windowed mode
	• Options of resolution
	• Ability to remap keys when playing on the keyboard
🔧 Bug fixes & various improvements

Ready to slap some more Romans?

📬 Stay connected!

notes.title: Important information!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Microids and Mr Nutz Studio, the developer of Asterix & Obelix: Slap them All!, are listening to players and community's feedback and wish to inform that an update is in the works! This update allowing the modification of several options (screen resolution, key mapping, language selection) will soon be available on Steam.

In addition, new languages will also come soon: 
- Simplified Chinese 
- Traditional Chinese
- Japanese 
- Polish
- Russian 

Moreover, thanks to the Steam Play Together feature option, you have the possibility to enjoy the game via online coop! Find out more about this feature in this tutorial: 

https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay?l=english#together

Our goal is to offer an optimal experience for Asterix & Obelix fans, but also to all Beat them Up aficionados and will make sure to provide you with regular updates regarding the upcoming patches.

Microids et Mr Nutz Studio
